source.method: get_jsx (inline-styles) + get_computed_styles + get_tokens + get_basic_info via the lead's read-only exporter .agents/tasks/replace-flags-with-settings/impl/paper-export.mjs (calls only those four read tools at http://127.0.0.1:29979/mcp, writes bytes verbatim); frames authored with write_html and duplicate_nodes in the Paper MCP (historical tool/version/access event, 2026-10-11). Active sources are mixed: 76 unchanged verbatim Paper exports and eight owner-approved repository-authored installation-settings-v2 derivatives (owner decision 2026-10-12; GPT6.1SOL), authored independently from the reviewed specification and original Paper design lineage. Original nodeId/pageId/fileId/URL identify ancestry only; the Paper nodes were not edited or re-exported. Each derivative source path/sha256 is its new repository identity. Existing computedStylesPath/hash fields remain original historical Paper snapshots, ancestry-only, and do not describe derivative geometry. Derivative inline JSX owns its styles. No new Paper access, exports, IDs, computed-style responses or export scores are claimed; original exports remain in source/.

assets.note: Brand mark referenced by background-image in the rail and phone app bar of every frame; vendored so renders need no network. Byte-identical to the settings-mocks asset of the same Paper asset id.

fonts.note: Geist and Geist Mono, the pinned enterprise-mocks files, reused as E03 does.

exportedPngNote: Paper PNG export is unavailable on this host: Paper Desktop cannot render (get_screenshot and export return blank images). No Paper PNG is saved. Visual self-check used a headless render of the exported JSX through the E03 pipeline.
assetNote: Every frame uses the E03 settings shell, so the rail and phone app bar reference the brand mark image (vendored under source/assets/).
